start.welcome:
Hi, {name}! 👋

I help you find universities and scholarships to study abroad.

/profile — fill in your profile
/match — see programs that fit you
/gpa — GPA converter
profile.intro: Let's fill in your profile. At any step you can tap "⏭ I'll fill this later" — your profile is saved even if incomplete.
profile.degree_level.prompt: Which degree are you applying for?
profile.gpa.scale_prompt: Which grading system is your GPA in?
profile.gpa.value_prompt: Enter your grade as a number (e.g. 4.4 or 87):
profile.gpa.value_invalid: Invalid value. Please enter a positive number.
profile.gpa.disclaimer: ⚠️ This is an approximate estimate. Your final GPA is determined by the university or a recognition body (WES, Uni-Assist, ANABIN). Don't rely on this number alone for an official application.
profile.lang_cert.type_prompt: Do you have a language certificate? Choose the type:
profile.countries.prompt: Which countries would you like to study in? You can pick several, then tap "✅ Done".
profile.countries.empty: There are no countries in the database yet. Please try again later.
profile.budget.prompt: What is your approximate annual budget (USD)?
profile.budget.invalid: Invalid amount. Please enter a positive number.
profile.age.invalid: Invalid age. Please enter a number.
profile.completed:
Your profile has been saved! ✅

Send /match to see programs that fit you.
match.no_target_countries_hint: Note: no country selected, so all countries were searched. Pick a country via /profile for more precise results.
match.title: 🔎 Programs that fit you
match.empty: No matching programs found. Fill in your profile (/profile) or try again later.
